S3 · Choose appointment time — Task B
You can cancel under My appointments.
• Focus order: 1 Back, 2 Date, 3 Times (one stop;
arrow keys move between choices), 4 Confirm
• A radio list (one choice) works with a keyboard
and on a phone. A calendar grid was considered
and not used: tiny targets and harder keyboard
• Only open slots are listed (UC-07: booked,
blocked and out-of-hours slots are removed).
The gap at 10:00 is a taken slot.
• The chosen slot is shown by a filled radio, a
thick border and a text summary, not colour
• The cancellation rule is visible before the
